Effective line: A queue of grey citizens, a grey ladle, a supervisor timing every scoop.
Suggested line: Grey citizens queue for grey paste while a supervisor times every scoop of the ladle.

Effective line: Beefcake bore, Gourmand vents, Necrocrat signs, Refusemancer drains. The junction crew lifts the scrap. Every Garbage becomes muscle.
Suggested line: A Beefcake bore, Gourmand vents, Necrocrat signs and Refusemancer drains all meet here, and the junction crew turns every scrap of Garbage into muscle.

Effective line: Vats the size of houses. Something in the third one is humming the national anthem.
Suggested line: The vats are the size of houses, and something in the third one is humming the national anthem.

Effective line: Behind a ration hatch: a real kitchen, a locked pantry and a badger in medals.
Suggested line: Behind the ration hatch is a real kitchen, with a locked pantry and a badger in medals standing guard over it.

Effective line: 'HALT. These tunnels do not exist. You are standing in nothing. I cannot allow you to have found it.'
Suggested line: 'HALT. These tunnels do not exist, so you are standing in nothing, and I cannot allow you to have found it.'

Effective line: At the end of the Vat Floor, behind a door with a hatch for rations, is a kitchen. A real one. Copper pans, a cold stove, and a badger in a medal-covered chef's coat guarding a locked pantry.
Suggested line: At the end of the Vat Floor, behind a door with a ration hatch, is a real kitchen: copper pans, a cold stove, and a badger in a medal-covered chef's coat guarding a locked pantry.

Effective line: ATTENTION! This is a restricted pantry! Those recipes are confiscated for the war effort!
Suggested line: ATTENTION! You are standing in a restricted pantry, soldier! Every recipe on those shelves has been confiscated for the war effort!

Effective line: What war? The war on FLAVOUR, son. Every citizen fed the same, at the same time, from the same tap. Perfect discipline.
Suggested line: Which war? The war on FLAVOUR, son! Every citizen fed the same ration, at the same minute, from the same tap, and not one complaint about the seasoning.

Effective line: Marlo says you can't taste it either.
Suggested line: Marlo says you can't taste it either. Is that why everyone else has to eat it?

Effective line: Taste is a weakness. Whisk formation! Golems, to the vats! Nobody touches my pantry!
Suggested line: Taste is a weakness, soldier, and I have none! Golems, whisk formation, to the vats! Nobody touches my pantry!

ID: data/encounters/encounter_scripts.json::Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Culinary Defense/0/line::0
Effective line: Battle rations! Taste is a weakness. Paste is a strategy!
Suggested line: Battle rations, issue! Taste is a weakness, and paste is a strategy!

ID: data/encounters/encounter_scripts.json::Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Culinary Defense/1/line::0
Effective line: Battle stations! This is not a drill, it is a soufflé!
Suggested line: Battle stations! This is not a drill, soldier, it is a souffle! Vats, FIRE!

Effective line: A SMUDGE. Is TREASON. ...It's on me, isn't it.
Suggested line: A SMUDGE is TREASON! ...It's on me, isn't it.

Effective line: The pantry door swings open. Shelves of confiscated jars: pickles, jams, a wheel of cheese with a ration number on it. Somewhere a vat coughs and stops.
Suggested line: The pantry door swings open on shelves of confiscated jars: pickles, jams, and a wheel of cheese with a ration number stamped on it. Out on the floor, a vat coughs and stops.

Effective line: I invented the paste because nobody could get it wrong. You can't burn paste. You can't oversalt it.
Suggested line: I invented the paste because nobody could get it wrong, soldier. You can't burn it, you can't oversalt it, and you can't spoil a regiment's dinner with it.

Effective line: You can't... taste it. I never could, you know. Not since the war that wasn't.
Suggested line: And you can't... taste it. I haven't tasted anything in years, you know. I thought if nobody could, nobody would notice that I couldn't.

Effective line: Then you'll learn. The Grand Chef is taking students. She starts everyone the same way: first, water.
Suggested line: Then you'll learn again. The Grand Chef is taking students, and she starts every one of them the same way: first, water.

Effective line: The great doors swing open, silent and perfectly balanced. Beyond them, a long hall, a red carpet and a smell of floor wax and lemons. Somewhere, a very long way away, someone is humming.
Suggested line: The great doors swing open, silent and perfectly balanced, onto a long hall and a red carpet that smells of floor wax and lemons. Somewhere a very long way off, someone is humming.

Effective line: 'Welcome,' says a quiet, polite voice from nowhere. 'Please wipe your feet. Please wipe your opinions. You are expected.'
Suggested line: 'Welcome,' says a quiet, polite voice from nowhere. 'Please wipe your feet, and your opinions, on the mat provided. You are expected.'

Effective line: 'THE SEED: Nature is untidy. Nature is inefficient. Nature disagrees with itself.
Suggested line: 'THE SEED: Nature is untidy, inefficient and forever disagreeing with itself.

Effective line: A seed, properly corrupted, can be made to agree with me. Plant in the Archdruid. Observe.
Suggested line: A seed, properly corrupted, can be made to agree with me. Plant it in the Archdruid, and observe.

Effective line: NOTE: it will spread. What grows will be orderly. I believe she will thank me.'
Suggested line: NOTE: it will spread, and what grows will be orderly. I believe she will thank me.'

Effective line: Guards in polished armour pour from the gatehouse. Not toward you. Toward her.
Suggested line: Guards in polished armour pour from the gatehouse, and they are not coming for you. They are coming for her.

Effective line: Miss {rescuer_full}, I presume. Former junior Path-ologist. Absent without leave. Removed one item of laboratory property, which has been walking about ever since.
Suggested line: Miss {rescuer_full}, I presume! Former junior Path-ologist, absent without leave, who removed one item of laboratory property that has been walking about ever since.

Effective line: Don't fret, Miss Vey. Your father is very understanding about these things. Take her home, gentlemen. The long way.
Suggested line: Don't fret, Miss Vey, your father is ever so understanding about these things. Take her home, gentlemen, and do take the long way.

Effective line: They are through a side door before you reach it. The door has no handle on this side. Of course it doesn't.
Suggested line: They are through a side door before you can reach it, and on this side the door has no handle at all.

Effective line: {rescuer}. Her name is {rescuer}. I never even asked.
Suggested line: {rescuer}. Her name is {rescuer}, and all that way I never once asked her.

Effective line: Solid gold, ten metres tall, polished until you can see your own worried face in them. They open before you touch them. That is the worst part.
Suggested line: Solid gold, ten metres tall, and polished until you can see your own worried face in them. They swing open before you touch them, which is somehow the worst part.

Effective line: Thousands of portraits of one man, in order. Each is a little taller, a little straighter, a little more perfect than the last. A story event.
Suggested line: Thousands of portraits of one man, hung in order, each a little taller, straighter and more perfect than the last. A story event.

Effective line: A knight made entirely of mirror plates, each of them showing only one face. It moves exactly like you. Then it stops doing that. (A battle.)
Suggested line: A knight made entirely of mirror plates, every one showing the same smiling face. It moves exactly like you, right up until it doesn't. (A battle.)

Effective line: A clerk at a tall desk, stamping everything that moves. Quite fast. Quite sad. His eyes never leave the paper. (A battle.)
Suggested line: A clerk at a tall desk stamps everything that moves, quickly and rather sadly. His eyes never leave the paper. (A battle.)

Effective line: The head of the Ministry of Correction: white gloves, kind eyes, a ruler. She is very, very gentle. That is what makes it frightening. (Elite)
Suggested line: The head of the Ministry of Correction, with white gloves, kind eyes and a ruler. She is very, very gentle, and that is what makes her frightening. (Elite)

Effective line: A narrow back corridor where the castle's servants work, silent and very fast, in matching grey. They do not smile. They have stopped. (A battle.)
Suggested line: A narrow back corridor where the castle's servants work in matching grey, silent and very fast. They do not smile any more; they have stopped trying. (A battle.)

Effective line: The old portraits lean against the wall, face to the plaster. Behind the last one: a small bag someone left. 'In case anyone comes looking for the real one,' says a note. You take it and go back.
Suggested line: The old portraits lean against the wall, faces to the plaster. Behind the last one someone has left a small bag and a note: 'In case anyone comes looking for the real one.' You take it and go back.

Effective line: 'I never once asked what was wrong with them. Please. The door on the left. Go and look.'
Suggested line: 'I never once asked what was wrong with them. Please, take the door on the left and go and look at them.'

Effective line: You take the form. It can be revoked, you suspect, on a technicality. You go back.
Suggested line: You take the form. Somewhere in all this paper there must be a technicality, and you suspect someone will find it.

Effective line: You leave the seed where it fell. Out of its dome it looks smaller. Most things here do. You go back.
Suggested line: You leave the seed where it fell. Out of its dome it looks smaller, as most things here do once you get close, and you go back.

Effective line: The smile never changes. Neither, you realise, does anything else here. It is strangely restful.
Suggested line: The smile never changes, and neither, you realise, does anything else in this place. It is strangely restful, and that frightens you more than the guards do.

Effective line: Heavier than it looks, worth more than it should be, and covered in your fingerprints in a building that remembers fingerprints.
Suggested line: It is heavier than it looks and worth more than it should be, and now it is covered in your fingerprints, in a building that remembers fingerprints.

Effective line: There is always one more than there should be. You wave. He waves second. You are, for a moment, a little less afraid of him.
Suggested line: There is always one more reflection than there should be. You wave, he waves a moment too late, and for a moment you are a little less afraid of him.

Effective line: The sign is older than the rest of the castle. It is painted by hand. Under it, in different ink, someone has written: 'He meant well.'
Suggested line: The sign is older than the rest of the castle and painted by hand. Beneath it, in different ink, someone has written: 'He meant well.'

Effective line: A lectern in the middle of a round room, a book open on it, a pen beside the book. The ink on the last page is still wet. He wrote this today.
Suggested line: A lectern stands in the middle of a round room, with a book open on it and a pen beside the book. The ink on the last page is still wet; he wrote this today.

Effective line: A quiet reading room, a lamp, a chair. Someone used to read here. Rest and restore HP.
Suggested line: A quiet reading room with one lamp and one chair. Someone used to read here every night. Rest and restore HP.

Effective line: A single long shelf where the reforms are filed in order. Each is a little bigger than the last. A deck challenge: can your deck keep its footing?
Suggested line: A single long shelf where the reforms are filed in order, each a little bigger than the last. A deck challenge: can your deck keep its footing?

Effective line: A tall brass automaton that files, stamps and shelves. It has been told the archive is complete. It is very sure. (Elite)
Suggested line: A tall brass automaton that files, stamps and shelves. It has been told the archive is complete, and it is very sure of that. (Elite)

Effective line: A single book on a stand, still open. The last page is still wet. A story event: the moment you see him as he sees himself.
Suggested line: A single book lies open on a stand, its last page still wet. A story event: the moment you see him as he sees himself.

Effective line: You sit in the old reading chair. It is worn exactly where one person sat, every night, for years. Someone made the lampshade by hand. It is a little crooked.
Suggested line: You sit in the old reading chair, which is worn exactly where one person sat every night for years. Someone made the lampshade by hand, and it is a little crooked.

Effective line: Plans for wells. Plans for a school lunch. Plans for a bridge that was actually built.
Suggested line: There are plans for wells, plans for a hot school lunch, and plans for a bridge that was actually built.

Effective line: They are good. They are so good. You roll up the best and take it, with something in your throat.
Suggested line: They are good. They are so good, and something catches in your throat as you roll up the best of them and take it.

Effective line: No one climbs. The stair has been polished. By seventeen people.
Suggested line: No one climbs this stair. It has been polished by seventeen people, and I will not have it scuffed.

Effective line: Roads, rivers, four districts, a hundred thousand tiny houses. Every one of them is exactly where he wants it.
Suggested line: Roads, rivers, four districts and a hundred thousand tiny houses, and every one of them is exactly where he wants it.

Effective line: Do hold still. You are very slightly out of alignment. There. Better.
Suggested line: Do hold still. You are a fraction of a degree out of alignment, and I find I cannot leave it. There, that is better.

Effective line: I only wanted it to be nice. For everyone. For their own good.
Suggested line: I only wanted it to be nice, for everyone. It was for their own good. Why won't anyone let it be for their own good?

Effective line: Each one is a little straighter, a little taller. By the last he is eleven feet tall, with no wrinkles and a smile that does not move. Under each: 'IMPROVED.'
Suggested line: Each one is a little straighter and a little taller, until by the last he is eleven feet tall, with no wrinkles and a smile that does not move. Under every one: 'IMPROVED.'

Effective line: In the ninth he looks so tired, and so sincere. You will not forget it. You see through the frame.
Suggested line: In the ninth he looks so tired, and so sincere, that you know you will not forget it. After that, none of the frames can fool you.

Effective line: You look at your feet. The carpet is red, and a little worn in the middle. That, at least, is honest. You feel a little steadier.
Suggested line: You look down at your feet. The red carpet is worn a little in the middle, which is the one honest thing in the room, and you feel steadier for it.

Effective line: The frame comes off with a squeal. Somewhere an alarm goes off, very politely: 'Please do not remove the improvements.' A hand-sized portrait falls and cuts your hand. The frame is worth a lot.
Suggested line: The frame comes off with a squeal, and an alarm goes off somewhere, very politely: 'Please do not remove the improvements.' A small portrait falls and cuts your hand, but the frame is worth a lot.

Effective line: Your face. Tired, dusty, crooked, entirely your own. It is the most welcome thing in the castle.
Suggested line: It is your face, tired and dusty and a little crooked, and entirely your own. It is the most welcome thing you have seen in this castle.

Effective line: A long white ward. Fifty beds. In each, a citizen in a grey gown with a small, fixed smile, looking at nothing.
Suggested line: A long white ward holds fifty beds, and in each lies a citizen in a grey gown with a small, fixed smile, looking at nothing.

Effective line: You sit by the bed and listen, for as long as it takes. It takes a long time. They tell you their names.
Suggested line: You sit by the beds and listen for as long as it takes, which is a long time, and one by one they tell you their names.

Effective line: You carry him out through a window. He is heavier than you expected. It costs you a little. It costs him far more.
Suggested line: You carry him out through a window. He is heavier than you expected, and it costs you something, though it has cost him far more.

Effective line: The first page is enough. Somebody will pay for this book. Somebody, one day, will read it aloud.
Suggested line: The first page is enough. Somebody will pay well for this book, and somebody, one day, will read it aloud.

Effective line: You sit on step two hundred and fifty, and look up at the very large clock. It has no hands. It has only a plate that says 'ON TIME'.
Suggested line: You sit on step two hundred and fifty and look up at the very large clock. It has no hands, only a brass plate that says 'ON TIME'.

Effective line: I have drawn up plans for six new ones. The Council has approved them. I did not sleep. It was wonderful.'
Suggested line: I have drawn up plans for six new ones, and the Council has approved every one. I did not sleep at all. It was wonderful.'

Effective line: It goes on. They are good. They are so good.
Suggested line: It goes on like that for years, and they are good. They are so good.

Effective line: He is not lying. That is the worst of it. You understand him a little, and you understand exactly what you will have to do.
Suggested line: He is not lying, and that is the worst of it. You understand him a little now, and you understand exactly what you will have to do.

Effective line: Ah. A visitor. Do come in.
Suggested line: Ah, a visitor. Do come in; I so rarely receive anyone who has not been summoned.

Effective line: Sorry. That's forest mud. I've walked a long way, and everyone I met on the way here was afraid of you.
Suggested line: Sorry, that's forest mud. I've walked a long way to get here, and everyone I met on the road was afraid of you.

Effective line: Afraid? Of what? Of order?
Suggested line: Afraid? Of order, perhaps, or of comfort, or of the dreadful burden of being safe?

Effective line: Of comfort? Of being safe? I have given them roofs, and hats, and rules.
Suggested line: I have given them roofs, and hats, and rules, and I have given each of them exactly the same amount of each, which is more than anyone before me ever managed.

Effective line: Every one of them has a number. Nobody is ever overlooked. Do you know how few kingdoms can say that?
Suggested line: Every one of them has a number, so that nobody is ever overlooked. Do you know how few kingdoms can say that? I do. I counted.

Effective line: Every unit, equal, in every way. Why must some of them be five? Why must anything be five?
Suggested line: Every unit was to be equal, in every way. Why must some of them be five? Why must anything ever be five?

Effective line: You took ten years from me. Whatever you took, it was not the part that matters, and strength is not control.
Suggested line: You took ten years from me, and whatever you took, it was not the part that matters. Strength is what you do with what's left, and strength is not control.

Effective line: You took ten years from me. I don't know everything you took. I know it wasn't the part that matters.
Suggested line: You took ten years from me. I don't know everything you took, but I know it wasn't the part that matters.

Effective line: Then they must be made the same. For their own good. Do you not see?
Suggested line: Then they must be made the same, for their own good. I had rather hoped that you, of all people, would see that.

Effective line: You are not listening. Nobody ever listens. (a breath) Very well. If you will not follow my rules, I shall use yours.
Suggested line: You are not listening; nobody ever listens. (a breath) Very well. If you will not follow my rules, I shall simply have to use yours.

Effective line: Your cards. Your plays. Your own deck, in my hands.
Suggested line: Your cards, your plays, your very own deck, held in my hands and played rather more tidily than you ever played it.

Effective line: And you still beat me. How?
Suggested line: And still you beat me. I should very much like to know how.

Effective line: You copied my cards. What I do with them is mine. A name is a blank page until you sign it.
Suggested line: You copied my cards, but what I do with them is mine. A name is a blank page until you sign it.

Effective line: And nobody files me under 'subject' again. No order outranks treating people with respect.
Suggested line: And nobody files me under 'subject' ever again. No order you could write outranks treating people with respect.

Effective line: You copied my cards. What I do with them is mine. A name is a blank page until you sign it.
Suggested line: You copied my cards, but what I do with them is mine. A name is a blank page until you sign it.

Effective line: I'm not your subject. You don't get to decide who I am.
Suggested line: Copying a face never made anyone a cook. You don't get to decide who I am.

Effective line: Nobody files me under 'subject' again. No order outranks treating people with respect.
Suggested line: Nobody files me under 'subject' ever again. No order you could write outranks treating people with respect.

Effective line: That is not true. I made the wells. I made the roads.
Suggested line: That is simply not true. I made the wells, and I made the roads.

Effective line: NO. No, no, no. The rules are PERFECT.
Suggested line: No. No, no, no. The rules are perfect. I checked every one of them myself, twice.

Effective line: The rules ARE perfect. If the rules are not perfect then I have been... then I have been...
Suggested line: The rules are perfect. They have to be, because if they aren't, then I have been... then all this time I have been...

Effective line: Everything is coming apart. Why is everything coming apart? I only wanted it to be nice!
Suggested line: Everything is coming apart, and I don't understand why. I only wanted it to be nice.

Effective line: 'The heart and the mind, son. You brought both. We are with you.' (Grandmaster Flex's Heart: Beefcake units get +1 power, and you gain 2 max HP.)
Suggested line: 'Strength is the heart and the mind, son, and you brought both. We're with you.' (Grandmaster Flex's Heart: Beefcake units get +1 power, and you gain 2 max HP.)

Effective line: The Grand Chef, in a clean apron, ladle in hand. 'Have you eaten? No. Of course you have not.'
Suggested line: The Grand Chef, in a clean apron, ladle in hand. 'Have you eaten? No, of course you haven't. Here. Eat first, fight after.'

Effective line: 'Ten years of sauce that tasted of nothing. Let us feed this kingdom something real.' (The Grand Chef's Feast: Gourmand units get +1 defense, life gain is stronger, and you gain 2 max HP.)
Suggested line: 'Ten years of sauce that tasted of nothing. Let's feed this kingdom something real again.' (The Grand Chef's Feast: Gourmand units get +1 defense, life gain is stronger, and you gain 2 max HP.)

Effective line: Nobody stands beside you. The Paths are not free yet: their leaders are still behind wheels, behind sauce and behind paperwork. You step into the chamber alone.
Suggested line: Nobody stands beside you. The Paths are not free yet, and their leaders are still held behind wheels and sauce and paperwork and thorns, so you step into the chamber alone.

Effective line: The model lies in pieces. A hundred thousand tiny houses on the floor, all in the wrong places, and somehow they look better.
Suggested line: The model lies in pieces, a hundred thousand tiny houses scattered across the floor in all the wrong places, and somehow they look better.

Effective line: ...It is over. The rules were not enough.
Suggested line: ...So it is over. I wrote such good rules, and they were not enough.

Effective line: I did it for them. I did it for the people. You do see that?
Suggested line: I did it for them, for the people. You do see that, don't you?

Effective line: You took my mother and father. I can't even remember their faces. I'm not burying that in a jar. I'm letting it go.
Suggested line: You took my mother and father, and I can't even remember their faces. I'm not going to keep that under glass the way you keep everything. I'm letting it go.

Effective line: You took my mother and father. I can't even remember their faces. I'm letting it go anyway. Watch.
Suggested line: You took my mother and father, and I can't even remember their faces. I'm letting it go anyway. Watch me.

Effective line: It was the mirrors. Wasn't it. I wanted a world where nothing could surprise me.
Suggested line: It was the mirrors, wasn't it? I wanted a world where nothing could ever surprise me.

Effective line: I'm not going to correct you. That was your way. Start smaller. Say sorry to one person.
Suggested line: I'm not going to correct you; that was always your way. Start smaller than that. Say sorry to one person.

Effective line: No crown. No perfect smile. Only a tired man kneeling above a very small kingdom.
Suggested line: There is no crown and no perfect smile, only a tired man kneeling above a very small kingdom.

Effective line: Somebody downstairs will pay for them. Nobody upstairs will miss them. That is the whole plan.
Suggested line: Somebody downstairs will pay for them and nobody upstairs will miss them, which is as much of a plan as you need.

Effective line: It is perfect. It is horrifying. Your face stays like that for a while, and the guards leave you alone.
Suggested line: The smile comes out perfect, which is horrifying, and your face stays like that for a while. The guards leave you alone.

Effective line: Where is the Lab?
Suggested line: Where is this Lab? Where did you take her?

Effective line: He withdraws, bravely, at a run. You fold the memo into your pocket. Beneath the forest. Her father.
Suggested line: He withdraws, bravely, at a run. You fold the memo into your pocket, and two phrases go with it: beneath the forest, and her father.
